# cs-source-reliable
English · 简体中文
Source reliability for CS teaching in DeepSeek Harness: a bundled registry of **119 verified, agent-
collectable CS sources** with authority/evidence tiers, plus two model-facing tools to find sources
and audit citations.
A plugin for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`). The registry covers the 17 CS2023 knowledge areas and ships a
s data; both tools are local lookups (no network calls), so they are fast and have no side effects.
## What it ships
- **119 sources** — 68 teaching-layer (textbooks, courses, official docs, standards) and 51 frontier

-layer (preprints, proceedings, release notes, advisories).
- Per source: authority tier (`A` primar
y spec/official docs/releases, `B` peer-reviewed/authoritative, `C` curated secondary, `D` lead only
), evidence type, `content_access` (static / portal / js / redirect / frameset / api / binary), `lic
ense_class`, `cache_policy`, `attribution`, `refresh_days`, `last_checked`, and the CS2023 areas it

serves.
- **Two tools**: `cs_source_find` and `cs_source_audit`.
- A short system-prompt section tha
t tells the model when to use them and how to cite.
## Tools
### `cs_source_find`
Find a source by URL, keyword, or CS2023 area code.

- `url` — match a page (host + path prefix).
- `query` — keywords, e.g. `"algorithm textbook"` or `"

RFC"`.
- `ka` — one of `AL AR CN DM DS FPL GV HCI IS MSF OS PDC SEC SE SEP SF SPD`.
- `layer` — `bre

adth` (teaching) or `depth` (frontier).
- `limit` — max results (default 5, ceiling 20).
Returns the compact record with tier, access mode and refresh policy. Example result:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Keyword ranking uses IDF-like token weighting with a subject-token boost, so `"python 3.13 release n
otes"` ranks Python sources above generic "release notes" pages.
### `cs_source_audit`
Audit the URL citations in a draft answer: map each URL to a known source, report its tier and acces
s mode, flag unknown domains and C/D-tier citations, count substantive paragraphs without a source,
wn domains and C/D-tier citations, count substantive paragraphs without a source, and suggest fixes.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Trigger rules
The plugin does not intercept requests. The model decides, guided by a system-prompt section (order
240, in the plugin-guidance band):
- call `cs_source_find` before stating CS facts that depend on versions, APIs, standards, or current
e-id] URL` plus the version or date the source states, and say "unsourced" when no registry source f

`cs_source_audit` on a draft that cites URLs before sending it;
- skip both tools for non-CS topics.
## Measured footprint (2026-11-06)
| Item | Measured |

| `cs_source_find` schema (name + description + parameters) | 893 chars ≈ 224 tokens |
| `cs_source_

audit` schema | 454 chars ≈ 114 tokens |
| Guidance section | 642 chars ≈ 161 tokens |
| **Combined

per-request overhead** | **≈ 498 tokens** (schemas + guidance) |
| Registry load | 0.7–2.6 ms |
| `c

s_source_find` latency | avg 0.081 ms, p95 0.15 ms (5,000 calls) |
| `cs_source_audit` latency | avg
0.022 ms (3,064-char draft, 500 calls) |
Token counts are character-based estimates at 4 chars/token; the two tool schemas and the guidance a
re prompt-cached along with the rest of the system prompt. Tool output is bounded (≤20 results, note
s truncated to 180 chars).

Requirements: DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`, Node.js 20+.

Restart or reload the profile after installing. The plugin row appears under Settings → Plugins as *
*CS source reliability**.
## Development
The registry source of truth is `data/cs-source-matrix.yaml` (119 sources with keywords, tiers and p
robe metadata); `data/sources.json` is generated from it.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`tools/apply-keywords.cjs` re-applies `tools/source-keywords.json` to the matrix; `tools/make-icon.p
y` regenerates the icon PNGs.
## Data provenance and maintenance
- Every source was probed on 2026-11-06: 118/119 returned HTTP 200; Semantic Scholar returned 429 (i

t needs an API key).
- `refresh_days` is a suggestion per source class: advisories 2 d, feeds/releas
es 7 d, official docs 30 d, peer-reviewed 90 d, specs 180 d, textbooks 365 d. `last_checked` is the

probe date.
- `license_class` / `cache_policy` are policy buckets, not legal advice: link to the sou
rce and quote briefly; full-text caching is only allowed for public-domain/open sources.
## Limitations
- The tools **look up a curated registry**; they do not fetch pages or verify claims on their own. S

ource-tier data is only as fresh as the last registry rebuild.
- `cs_source_audit` is a mechanical c
heck (URL extraction, tier mapping, uncited-paragraph count). It does not judge whether a cited sour

ce actually supports a sentence.
- A/B tiers reduce risk; they do not guarantee correctness. Version

-sensitive claims still need the version/date the source states.
- Non-registry URLs are flagged as
unknown even when legitimate (e.g. a project's own GitHub repository is not a CS knowledge source).
## License
MIT. The registry contains only source names, URLs and policy metadata; the referenced content remai
ns under each source's own terms.
